description: Secure coding principles are not applied to software development. This signal indicates that developers lack secure coding standards, guidelines, training, or enforcement mechanisms to prevent common vulnerabilities such as injection flaws, authentication bypasses, and insecure data handling.
applicability: Applicable to all software development activities including application code, infrastructure as code, scripts, automation, configuration files, and any software artifacts. Covers all programming languages, frameworks, and development environments including web, mobile, cloud, and embedded systems development.

metadata.detection_notes: Commonly detected through code review, static analysis security testing (SAST), secure coding standards documentation review, developer training records, code quality metrics, and vulnerability assessments. May also be identified through presence of common vulnerability patterns in code.
